title: Chapter 341 Mr. Jiang
content:
Chapter 341 Mr. Jiang

"Did the old man leave because I suddenly disappeared?"

Otherwise, with Mr. Jiang's physical fitness at the time, he would not have passed away so soon.

"What did you say? Brother, my grandfather is not dead yet."

As soon as Lu Daosheng finished speaking, Jiang Xiaoxiao said with a complaining look on his face.

"ah?"

Lu Daosheng was stunned.

"The old man isn't dead?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao gave Lu Daosheng a blank look and said, "Bah, you're dead."

"You actually cursed my grandfather to die. I'm going to complain to my grandfather!"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng's face suddenly turned awkward.

But I was extremely happy.

It's good that you haven't died, then everything doesn't matter.

The two most important people here are still here, and nothing is more happy than this.

"However, although grandpa didn't leave, his condition is not very good now."

At this time, Jiang Xiaoxiao suddenly lowered her head and said with a dim expression.

Lu Daosheng naturally heard what Jiang Xiaoxiao meant.

Isn’t it just that he is sick? What’s the matter? With his current ability, it’s not a problem to let Mr. Jiang live for a lifetime.

If you die, it will be a little trouble.

After all, with his current strength, he cannot be resurrected.

This place is different from other worlds. Here, the power Lu Daosheng can use is very small.

Of course, this is inevitable. Otherwise, if Lu Daosheng doesn't pay attention and directly blows up the entire Blue Star, it will be really not worth the effort and he has no place to cry.

"You, you are still laughing, you are really heartless!"

Seeing that he said that his grandfather was in a bad condition now, Lu Daosheng actually had a smile. Jiang Xiaoxiao immediately bulged his face and pointed at Lu Daosheng and scolded him a little.

Lu Daosheng disappeared for eight years for no reason. Now that he is back, he hears that his grandfather is in a bad condition, he can forget that he doesn't think of a solution, but how can he gloat?

This made Jiang Xiaoxiao very confused.

She didn't believe that her brother who had been calling him for so many years would be an ungrateful wolf.

Seeing that he was misunderstood, Lu Daosheng quickly restrained his smile and his expression became solemn.

"Xiaoxiao, take me to see the old man."

Looking at Lu Daosheng's serious gaze, Jiang Xiaoxiao wanted to mutter a few words, but immediately swallowed it again.

The two stopped talking nonsense, and Jiang Xiaoxiao drove Lu Daosheng directly to the hospital.

Along the way, both of them were silent.

While Jiang Xiaoxiao was driving, Yu Guang kept looking at Lu Daosheng sitting in the passenger seat.

In her heart, Lu Daosheng must have been fooled by someone, and he finally came back lately.

As for what Lu Daosheng said, she didn't care at all, but she felt a little pitiful about Lu Daosheng's experience.

The once enthusiastic and cheerful young brother has now become like this.

well.

Jiang Xiaoxiao sighed in her heart.

Lu Daosheng, who was standing beside him, looked at the scenery of the city outside the window and felt the modern society, and felt a little emotional inside.

Although it has been eight years here, the changes are also very big.

But no matter how the changes change, Lu Daosheng could feel a familiar feeling after he came back.

That is something that Lu Daosheng could never feel in other worlds.

At this time, Jiang Xiaoxiao did not notice that behind him, a black sedan was quietly following behind him.

Lu Daosheng naturally noticed it, but he didn't take it seriously.

No need.

From the moment he came back, the whole world was in his control.

As long as he wants, it is no problem to unify globally.

Jiang Xiaoxiao had good driving skills, and there were no accidents on the road. In just a while, the two of them arrived at the hospital.

Immediately, Jiang Xiaoxiao was familiar with the road and took Lu Daosheng directly to a ward.

There is only one bed in the ward.

The patient in the bed was Mr. Jiang who Lu Daosheng thought about day and night.

This old man who raised him.

"Grandpa, who are you here?"

Looking at Mr. Jiang, who was getting thinner and bloodless, Jiang Xiaoxiao's eyes were moist and she slowly stepped forward and said softly.

Hearing his granddaughter's voice, Jiang Guowei's eyelids trembled slightly and he opened his eyes with difficulty.

When Mr. Jiang saw his granddaughter coming to see him, Mr. Jiang squeezed out a smile.

"Xiaoxiao, you are here again."

Jiang Xiaoxiao nodded and stepped forward and held Mr. Jiang's hand tightly.

At this moment, Mr. Jiang's hands were covered with pinholes, and there was almost only one skinny bone left.

This made Jiang Xiaoxiao feel even more distressed.

"Grandpa, see who I brought?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao spoke again.

Hearing this, Old Master Jiang noticed Lu Daosheng behind Jiang Xiaoxiao.

The moment he saw Lu Daosheng, Old Master Jiang was stunned, with a hint of disbelief in his eyes.

But the next moment, a hint of color popped up in his eyes.

"Xiaosheng, is it you? You, you are back!"

Mr. Jiang said excitedly.

At this time, a middle-aged man in a white coat slowly walked into the ward.

Seeing that Mr. Jiang was obviously excited, he frowned slightly and hurriedly stepped forward to comfort him, "Old Jiang, don't be excited, take a deep breath."

Mr. Jiang could not hear what the doctor said at this moment, but just looked at Lu Daosheng, his hands trembling.

"Xiaosen, come here and come to me."

Looking at Mr. Jiang at this time, Lu Daosheng was also a little moved.

Unexpectedly, after eight years of not seeing each other, the old man really missed him so much.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng walked to Mr. Jiang.

Jiang Xiaoxiao gave up a position because she was sensible.

Bang!

At this time, a light sound rang from Lu Daosheng's face.

I saw that Lu Daosheng walked to Mr. Jiang, and Mr. Jiang slapped Lu Daosheng in the face without hesitation.

It’s just that Mr. Jiang doesn’t have much strength now, so Lu Daosheng doesn’t feel much at all.

But even so, Lu Daosheng was still a little dazed.

No one has dared to hit himself in many years.

However, he was not angry at all, but was still a little happy.

"Where have you been dead over the years? I don't know if you come back to see me!"

Mr. Jiang's hoarse voice sounded loudly from the ward.

After saying that, Mr. Jiang began to cough constantly, and the doctor beside him shook his head.

"Miss Jiang, prepare for the funeral."

He patted Jiang Xiaoxiao on the shoulder and the doctor sighed.

Hearing this, Jiang Xiaoxiao was stunned and cried with a wow sound.

"grandfather!"

"Doctor, please save my grandpa, I beg you."

Jiang Xiaoxiao was like grabbing a life-saving straw, pulling the doctor's arm hard and shaking it constantly.

But the doctor shook his head.

"Miss Jiang, Mr. Jiang has been hospitalized for three years. With Mr. Jiang's original situation, we have tried our best to survive until now."

"Yes, but my grandfather is only in his seventies."

"It's over seventy, and it's already a lot."

Hearing the doctor say this, Jiang Xiaoxiao had to sit helplessly on the ground, hugging her legs and crying helplessly.

At this time, Mr. Jiang's aura was indeed gradually weakening.

The heartbeat is getting weaker and weaker.

Seeing that Mr. Jiang was about to close his eyes forever, Lu Daosheng finally took action.

In an instant, the entire ward seemed to have time paused.

Everyone stopped.

This is naturally Lu Daosheng's work.

Lu Daosheng walked indifferently to Mr. Jiang and placed one hand on Mr. Jiang's forehead.

In a moment, Mr. Jiang's situation made Lu Daosheng clear at a glance.

It doesn’t happen if someone poisons or someone secretly causes trouble.

It seemed that Mr. Jiang's body was gradually weakening because of his sudden disappearance.

Lu Daosheng smiled bitterly and quickly injected a strong vitality into Mr. Jiang's body.

In just an instant, Mr. Jiang's aura gradually increased.
